2026-10-10 06:09:21.576093 | controller | Also=, or Alias= settings in the [Install] section, and DefaultInstance= for
2026-10-10 06:09:21.576106 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-10-10 06:09:21.576112 | controller |
2026-10-10 06:09:21.576119 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-10-10 06:09:21.576139 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-10-10 06:09:21.576143 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-10 06:09:21.576148 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-10 06:09:21.576158 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-10 06:09:21.576169 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-10-10 06:09:21.576174 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
